title: _In vitro class_ switching staining for flow cytometry
protocol: Harvest splenocytes by grinding spleens in RPMI-1640 medium between two frosted microscope slides.
Spin cells at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Remove erythrocytes by adding one equivalent volume of ACK Lysing Buffer to the remaining pellet.
Gently resuspend and swirl tube for 1 minute.
Fill tube with 10 ml of RPMI-1640, centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 10 ml of RPMI-1640.
Filter through a 70 μm nylon cell strainer.
Centrifuge at 1000 RPM for 5 minutes.
Resuspend 1 × 10^7 cells in 500 μl of FACS buffer.
Obtain B cells by CD43 negative purification using anti-CD43 magnetic beads.
Dilute CD43-negative B cells to a concentration of 5×10^5 cells/ml in B cell complete medium.
Incubate 5×10^5 B cells in the presence of 10 μg/ml of anti-CD40 (clone 3/23) and 10 ng/ml of recombinant mouse IL-4 for IgG1 analysis.
Incubate for 4 days at 37°C in a humidified 5% CO2 incubator.
Wash cells with FACS buffer.
Preincubate cells on ice for 10 minutes in the presence of Fc blocker (anti-CD16/CD32).
Stain cells with biotinylated anti-IgG1 and anti-IgG2a-2b antibodies at a dilution of 1:200.
Incubate on ice for 20 minutes.
Wash cells twice with FACS buffer.
Stain cells with the chosen streptavidin conjugate.
Wash cells twice with FACS buffer.
Analyze stained cells by flow cytometry.
